hard_rejection_gate_assessment.engineering_judgment: REJECT. Three independent, mutually-reinforcing findings support this: (1) the target failure mode - generic-A collapse on a genuinely ambiguous/underspecified query - recurred on entirely fresh, non-overlapping pilot material after the one allowed revision was applied, meaning the revision did not fix the problem it was designed to fix; (2) intent accuracy is unchanged in aggregate (6/8, same as before); (3) a real, disclosed entity-extraction regression (2/13 gold target entities missed on a 'using X inhibitors' construction, versus 16/16 in the prior pilot) was also observed this round, which independently fails the 'no entity regression' gate (Step 16) regardless of the intent-gate outcome. Per the task's explicit, pre-committed rule ('if the same pattern... recurs after this one revision, GPT-OSS is rejected for Phase 2, permanently, no further tuning'), no second revision is attempted and no full dev run is performed.
